name: X Ultra 4 GTX Hiking Boot
description: Premium women's hiking boot with Gore-Tex waterproof membrane and Contagrip sole. Built for technical terrain with advanced chassis for stability on uneven ground. Perfect for day hikes and multi-day backpacking trips in wet conditions.

name: Hubba Hubba 2P Tent
description: Iconic 2-person backpacking tent with freestanding design and dual vestibules. Ultralight at just 2 lbs 14 oz, it packs small for long approaches. Full mesh canopy for ventilation on warm summer nights with excellent rain protection.

name: Atmos AG 65 Pack
description: Award-winning 65L backpacking pack with Anti-Gravity suspension for all-day comfort under heavy loads. Features integrated rain cover, sleeping bag compartment, and multiple access points. Ideal for week-long camping and hiking trips.

name: Flash Cooking System
description: All-in-one cooking system that boils water in just 100 seconds. FluxRing technology maximizes fuel efficiency, and the 1L insulated cup doubles as a cooking pot. Push-button igniter and compact nesting design for backcountry cooking.

name: Phantom 15F Sleeping Bag
description: Premium 15F down sleeping bag with 800-fill Q.Shield DOWN that resists moisture. Laminated construction eliminates cold spots, and the tapered mummy shape maximizes warmth-to-weight ratio. Packs down to the size of a football.

name: Trail Ergo Cork Trekking Poles
description: Ergonomic cork-grip trekking poles with FlickLock Pro adjustability. Dual-density cork and foam grip reduces hand fatigue on long hikes. Carbide tips provide traction on rock, and interchangeable baskets work for trail and snow.

name: Trail Series Wide Mouth 32oz
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Wide mouth fits ice cubes and is easy to clean. BPA-free and made with 18/8 pro-grade stainless steel for trail-tough durability.

name: Moji Camp Lantern
description: Compact LED camp lantern with frosted globe for soft, ambient light. Single-power LED provides up to 100 lumens with 70-hour runtime. Collapsible for packing, with a built-in hook for hanging in your tent or at the campsite.

name: Chair One Camp Chair
description: Ultra-lightweight camp chair weighing just 2 lbs with advanced DAC aluminum alloy frame. Supports up to 320 lbs and sets up in seconds with shock-corded poles. Packs down to the size of a water bottle for backpacking trips.

name: Beta LT Gore-Tex Jacket
description: Lightweight, packable Gore-Tex waterproof jacket built for mountain weather. Trim fit layers easily over a fleece or down jacket. Helmet-compatible hood, WaterTight zippers, and pit zips for ventilation during high-output activities.

name: Moab 3 Mid Waterproof Boot
description: Classic mid-cut hiking boot with waterproof membrane and Vibram TC5+ outsole. Bellows tongue keeps debris out, and the contoured footbed provides arch support for long days on the trail. A proven favourite for hikers of all levels.

name: Radar EV Path Sport Sunglasses
description: High-performance sport sunglasses with Prizm lens technology that enhances colour and contrast on the trail. Lightweight O-Matter frame with Unobtainium earsocks that grip better with sweat. Full UV protection for all-day outdoor use.

name: Pinnacle Camper Cookset
description: Complete camp cookware set with non-stick coated pots, fry pan, and nesting mugs. Crushproof nylon stuff sack keeps everything organized. Telescoping foldable handle locks securely for safe cooking at the campsite.

name: PocketRocket Deluxe Stove
description: Ultralight canister stove with built-in pressure regulator for consistent performance in cold weather. WindClip windscreen improves efficiency, and the wider pot supports accommodate larger cookware. Weighs just 2.9 oz.

name: Adventure Base Camp Cook Set
description: Rugged stainless steel camp cook set that nests for easy transport. Includes 3.5L pot, vented lid, two bowls, and a cutting board. Built to withstand years of campfire use with legendary Stanley durability.

name: Trek 1400 Titanium Pot
description: Ultralight titanium pot with 1.4L capacity perfect for solo backpackers. Foldable handles lock in place for secure cooking. Titanium heats quickly and is incredibly strong at a fraction of the weight of steel.

name: Copper Spur HV UL3 Tent
description: Ultralight 3-person tent with high-volume architecture for maximum livability. Semi-freestanding design with steep walls creates spacious interior. Two doors and vestibules for easy access, with awning mode for warm evenings.

name: Hornet Elite 2P Tent
description: Ultralight 2-person tent at just 1 lb 15 oz one of the lightest freestanding tents available. Volumetric design maximizes headroom and interior space. Ideal for weight-conscious backpackers on multi-day trips.

name: NeoAir Dream Sleeping Bag
description: Insulated sleeping bag with SynergyLink connectors that attach to your sleeping pad, eliminating cold spots and preventing you from rolling off. Lightweight synthetic fill performs well in damp conditions.

name: Stargaze Recliner Camp Chair
description: Innovative suspended reclining camp chair that swings and reclines like a hammock. Auto-recline design lets you lean back naturally. Premium comfort for stargazing, campfire evenings, and lazy camp mornings.

name: Alpha FL 30 Pack
description: Ultralight 30L alpine pack built for fast-and-light missions. Minimalist design with removable framesheet and top-loading access. Hydration compatible with gear loops for ice tools. Perfect for day hikes and alpine scrambles.

name: Zodiac Plus GTX Boot
description: Technical mountain boot with Gore-Tex waterproofing and Vibram Drumlin sole for excellent grip on wet rock. Sock-fit construction eliminates pressure points on long approaches. Built for demanding alpine terrain and via ferrata.

name: Spark SP III Sleeping Bag
description: Ultra-compact sleeping bag with 850+ fill RDS-certified down. Packs down to the size of a one-litre water bottle. 3D side wall construction maximizes insulation without added weight. Perfect for gram-conscious backpackers.

name: Lite+ Compact Stove
description: Compact all-in-one stove system with piezo ignition and integrated 0.5L pot. Laminar flow burner provides efficient, wind-resistant flame. Neoprene cozy keeps drinks warm. Ideal for solo backpacking and fast boils on the trail.

name: Chute Mag 25oz Bottle
description: Durable water bottle with magnetic cap that stows out of the way while drinking. Ergonomic carry handle and spill-proof design. BPA/BPS-free Tritan Renew material made with 50% recycled content.

name: Stormbreak 3 Tent
description: Durable 3-person tent designed for car camping and frontcountry adventures. Easy setup with colour-coded clips and poles. Full-coverage rainfly and bathtub floor keep you dry. Roomy vestibule stores boots and gear.

name: AlpenGlow 500 Lantern
description: USB-rechargeable camp lantern with ChromaReal LED technology for true-to-life colour rendering. Multi-colour modes for ambiance, plus bright white for task lighting. 500 lumens max with up to 200 hours on low.

name: Wide Mouth Sustain 32oz
description: The classic wide-mouth water bottle made with 50% certified recycled Tritan Sustain material. Virtually indestructible and dishwasher safe. Wide mouth fits ice cubes and is easy to fill at camp.

name: Lighthouse 600 Lantern
description: Versatile rechargeable lantern that doubles as a USB power bank to charge your devices. Hand crank for emergency charging when solar is not available. 600 lumens with adjustable brightness and collapsible legs.

name: Flexlite Air Camp Chair
description: Ultralight camp chair at just 1 lb. DAC aluminum frame with breathable mesh seat. Packs down small for backpacking but still provides genuine comfort around camp.

name: Positron Screwgate Carabiner
description: Lightweight locking carabiner with keylock nose for snag-free clipping. Screwgate locking mechanism for security on belays and rappels. Hot-forged construction for maximum strength at minimum weight.

name: Am'D Tri-Lock Carabiner
description: Asymmetric D-shaped locking carabiner ideal for belaying and rappelling. Tri-Lock auto-locking mechanism prevents accidental opening. Keylock system eliminates snagging.

name: Pescador Pro 12.0 Kayak
description: Versatile sit-on-top kayak built for fishing and recreational paddling. Removable stadium seat provides all-day comfort. Multiple rod holders and gear tracks for customization.

name: Makalu FX Carbon Trekking Poles
description: Premium carbon fibre trekking poles with SpeedLock 2 adjustment system. Aergon Thermo grip provides comfort in cold conditions. Carbon construction absorbs vibration and reduces fatigue on long descents.

name: Nano Puff Insulated Jacket
description: Lightweight insulated jacket with 60g PrimaLoft Gold Eco insulation made from 100% postconsumer recycled content. Windproof and water-resistant shell. Packs into its own internal chest pocket.

name: Aerospace Snow Goggles
description: High-performance snow goggles with photochromic REACTIV lens that automatically adjusts to changing light conditions. SuperFlow ventilation system prevents fogging. Helmet compatible.

name: MC-2 Navigator Compass
description: Professional-grade sighting compass with clinometer for measuring slopes and heights. Global needle works in all hemispheres. Luminescent markings for low-light use.

name: Renegade GTX Mid Boot
description: Legendary all-leather hiking boot with Gore-Tex lining and Vibram EVO sole. Polyurethane Monowrap frame provides stability on uneven terrain. One of the most popular hiking boots in the world.

name: Baltoro 75 Pack
description: Expedition-ready 75L pack with Response A3 suspension that adapts to your body as you move. U-zip sleeping bag access, raincover included, and multiple organization pockets.

name: Aircontact Lite 50+10 Pack
description: Versatile 50+10L trekking pack with Aircontact back system for excellent ventilation. VariFlex hip belt moves with your body on technical terrain. Height-adjustable lid and expandable collar.

name: Vapor 10 Recreational Kayak
description: Stable and comfortable recreational kayak perfect for lakes and calm rivers. Adjustable padded seat with high back support. Large cockpit for easy entry and exit.

name: Expedition S Compass
description: Reliable baseplate compass with DryFlex grip for secure handling in wet conditions. Detachable safety-release lanyard and luminous points for nighttime navigation.

name: Stradic FL Spinning Reel
description: High-performance spinning reel with Hagane Body and Hagane Gear for smooth, powerful retrieval. Technically outdoor gear, but designed for angling, not camping or hiking.

name: Battle III Spinning Combo
description: Rod and reel combo for saltwater and freshwater fishing. Full metal body reel with HT-100 carbon fibre drag system. Outdoor gear for the angler, not the camper.

name: Ergo Trowel
description: Ergonomic garden trowel with FiberComp construction. While technically outdoor gear, this is for the garden not the campsite.

name: Auto Reel Wall-Mounted Hose
description: Wall-mounted auto-retracting garden hose reel with 65ft hose. Great for outdoor watering but you will not find this at the campsite.

name: Rogue ST Max Iron Set
description: Premium golf iron set with AI-designed Flash Face. Outdoor sport equipment for the golf course, not the hiking trail.

name: Stealth 2 Driver Set
description: Carbon-faced driver with 60X Carbon Twist Face for explosive distance. An outdoor sport product for the fairway, not the forest.

name: 20V MAX XR Cordless Drill
description: Professional-grade cordless drill/driver with brushless motor. Great for construction projects but definitely not camping gear.

name: 18V LXT Impact Driver
description: Compact impact driver with variable speed trigger. A power tool for the workshop, not the wilderness.

name: Planting Tool Set
description: Three-piece garden tool set with trowel, transplanter, and cultivator. Perfect for the garden but you will not need these on a camping trip.
